posts.zh:
dsh-voice 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 全双工语音对话：输入框麦克风（RMS 端点检测）配合浏览器本地 whisper 转写，回复按句流式朗读，开口说话即打断播放与正在运行的回合（真 barge-in），无需 API key。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dc26248804dfb3a62bd1.html
posts.en:
dsh-voice is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: a composer mic (RMS endpoint detection) transcribes speech with whisper running locally in the browser, assistant replies stream back as spoken audio sentence-by-sentence, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dc26248804dfb3a62bd1.html
